mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was most worthwhile: the separate regions became a recognizable body, and the explanation showed how the food pipe, nerves and vessels cross between them.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the skin segment was clear but less engaging as a decision: it was the only offered combination and its opening was already marked.

surprise.text: The finished body still shows cells being replaced in the skin and marrow, rather than presenting the body as a static assembly.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the final skin actions were largely guided by the marked opening and the only offered pair rather than by figuring out compatibility.

continue.text: Probably not immediately. Seeing the separate structures come together was satisfying, but the last choices were mostly straightforward assembly, so I would want a new kind of challenge.
